rank_invariance_argument: The IBD nuisance layer depends only on within-species order. Any strictly positive scalar multiple of geographic distance is the same mathematical IBD ordering. For the exactly noise-free, zero-residual calibration arm, choosing canonical positive scale 1 removes floating order collapse without changing the rank estimand.
allowed_change: If residual_amplitude=0, noise_sd=0, and ibd_strength>0, set synthetic genetic edge distance exactly equal to geographic edge distance. If ibd_strength=0, retain an exactly zero genetic-distance vector.
required_validation: all 221 frozen Decker species have identical weak rank order in pure-IBD world
private/shared benchmark worlds remain the same frozen seeds and parameters
